name: Beyond the Pursuit
source:
"I couldn't wait for someone to want me like a lover. Nicky's attraction stopped at hunger; he wanted me like a wolf wanted it's prey."

"But he still wanted me."

...Is what twenty-something Rory thinks when he finds himself coerced into feeding the gross but strangely alluring Nicky, a vampire with looks and little charm.

Rory is a twenty something with an average life, good friends, a nice apartment, the works. But still, he wishes for something more. With the desire to step out of his comfort zone, he ventures into a bar with two of his roommates. There, although he can't remember this meeting, he runs into Nicky, and things complicate quickly.

As his relationships develop, what happens when his best friend reveals her shared past with this man? What happens when Rory develops feelings for his sweet, shy best friend as well as his manipulator?

And... what will YOU choose when it comes down to it? You only have one choice. Make it count.

translation:
“我迫不及待地希望有人像爱人一样想要我。尼基的吸引力因饥饿而停止；他想要我就像狼想要猎物一样。”

“但他还是想要我。”

……二十多岁的罗里发现自己被迫喂食恶心但异常诱人的尼基（一个长相奇特但缺乏魅力的吸血鬼）时的想法。

罗里（Rory）二十多岁，生活平淡，有好朋友，有一套漂亮的公寓，工作正常。但他仍然希望得到更多。由于渴望走出自己的舒适区，他和两个室友冒险进入了一家酒吧。在那里，虽然他不记得这次会面，但他遇到了尼基，事情很快就变得复杂起来。

随着他的关系不断发展，当他最好的朋友透露她与这个男人共同的过去时，会发生什么？当罗里对他可爱、害羞的好朋友以及他的操纵者产生感情时，会发生什么？

而且…当谈到这个问题时，你会选择什么？你只有一个选择。让它算数。
